scope: Independent source review and actual focused source/hook/static-render regression. This is an unpublished working-tree candidate based on 26e80ae9, not part of that published CI result.
verdict: No remaining source-review objection at these final candidate hashes, including verified-guest invalidation. Final owner Node and actual Next integration receipts were reviewed and source-bound separately from the prior independent focused execution.
reviewedProperties: Only existing server-verified AppShell identity fields are recorded; no page content, private arbitrary fields, JWTs or authorization decisions are cached.
Both captured/live snapshots require initialized, unchanged, exact owner/scope/revision. Scope replacement, sign-out and A-to-B-to-A reject late writes and reads.
The no-await recorder checks the render snapshot at layout-effect commit; the sticky changed guard is independent of the root session boundary.
All current ordinary AppShell layouts are eligible; public/auth/professional/unknown-profile routes remain neutral even with a colliding recorded username.
Only configured-origin canonical public avatars are replayed; signed, authenticated, query-bearing, opaque or unrelated-origin locators become initials.
Passive chrome mounts links/status only, with prefetch disabled; it mounts no unread query hooks, call layer, lightbox, scroll manager, editable input or compose action.
Collapsed width and frame margin agree without owning the global nav-collapsed class or adding storage listeners.
Loading skip link targets a distinct loading-main-content ID, avoiding retained hidden Suspense content.
The existing scoped cache expires the record at thirty minutes on read.
resolvedDuringReview: Explicit reserved-route exclusions added before own-profile matching.
Broad capability-URL blacklist replaced by a first-party public-avatar allowlist.
Loading main/skip target separated from ordinary main-content.
Test loader supplied its actual filename so generic TypeScript is not parsed as JSX.
limitations: Focused tests use synthetic sessions/cache and actual helper/recorder/rendering boundaries. The real Next owner proof uses one synthetic signed-in account and local HTTP Auth/database; it does not establish hosted authorization or physical-device performance.
Retained chrome can make navigation available during loading without reducing the server response time itself.
No source changes, app deployments, hosted writes or branch publication were performed by the reviewer.

finalDeltaReview.verifiedGuest: The null-identity recorder removes only the exact current initialized, unchanged owner/scope/revision entry. A late captured old-scope guest effect cannot erase a replacement session snapshot. No guest identity is recorded.
finalDeltaReview.passiveBrand: Collapsed chrome uses the existing local /logo.png with no active app layer or network authorization change.
finalDeltaReview.neutralRenderCoverage: Owner added actual fallback rendering checks for public, auth, professional, unknown-profile and unresolved session cases.
